### MOD INFORMATION

* Champion: Yasuo
* Modified skin: Default
* Author: Zamius
* Mod version: 1.0.1 (19.08.2025 updated all 4 skins)
* Description: 4 colored Yasuo’s default/base skins: Red (Blood), Black (Dark Blade), White (Master of Wind), and Green (Forest Guardian). This mod also includes a custom loading screen for each chroma!

### FEATURES

* New textures
* Supports all champion texture quality settings
* Modified loading screens

### ABOUT THE MOD

* In the download link, you will find all 4 chromas, but you can use only 1 at a time in CSLoL-Manager!

### CREDITS

* [LxVer (the skull guy)](https://www.twitch.tv/lxver8) for coloring the loading screen splash-arts/portraits
